anchored_paragraphs: Electrified vehicles, or xEVs, include hybrids (HEVs), plug-in hybrids (PHEVs) and battery electric vehicles (BEVs). In the supplied market baseline, xEVs rose from 11.9% of Indonesian new-car wholesales in 2024 to 21.8% in 2025. Published figures put 2025 hybrid wholesales at 65,943 units, including 23,934 Innova Zenix hybrids, the leading model (Gabungan Industri Kendaraan Bermotor Indonesia [GAIKINDO], 2026). Aftersales supplied 46.7% of Auto2000’s gross profit across all powertrains. That makes the relationship after delivery commercially important as more households consider electrified cars.
